onscreen_lines.desc: Deer Protection: Firm fixed price per tree for Contractor to supply and install tree guards for 366 young trees at addresses to be shared with the Contractor at the time of the pre-installation meeting. These tree guards shall be installed to prevent rub damage from deer. Tree guards shall be heavy-duty white plastic tubing with a minimum of a 2-inch gap between the trunk and the tree guard material.
